name: tcia_prostate_3t
title: TCIA Prostate-3T: 64 T2-weighted prostate MRIs (DICOM)
description: Axial T2-weighted 3 T prostate MRIs of 64 patients (Radboud), the images behind the MSD prostate task. Series are listed through the public NBIA API (no account) and each one is downloaded as a zip of DICOM files on first access; the folder is then a DICOM volume (LPS mm from the headers).
